name: Find the cause of symptoms
definition: The participant describes symptoms or a health change and asks what is causing it or what condition they might have. The help wanted is a possible explanation or diagnosis for something they or someone else is experiencing.

name: Ways to relieve or manage
definition: The participant asks what they can do, take or change to relieve a current symptom or manage an existing problem. The help wanted is practical self-care or treatment advice.

name: General health facts
definition: The participant asks for factual information about a condition, symptom, treatment or body measure, not tied to working out their own case. The help wanted is an explanation, list or fact.

name: Deciding about medical care
definition: The participant asks for help deciding whether, when or from whom to get medical care, or what a planned appointment or procedure will involve. The help wanted is guidance on using the health care system.

name: Check if normal or safe
definition: The participant asks whether something they are experiencing or planning is normal, typical, expected or safe. The help wanted is reassurance or a yes-or-no judgement on their own situation.

name: Interpret results or numbers
definition: The participant shares a test result, report or health number and wants it read or explained for their case. The help wanted is interpretation of their own data.

name: Personal diet or supplement plan
definition: The participant states wellness, fitness or health goals and asks for tailored recommendations on foods, meals or supplements. The help wanted is a plan or product suggestions fitted to their goals and situation.

name: Help with a writing task
definition: The participant asks the AI to work on a piece of text or project, such as summarizing a section, drafting writing or adding material to an ongoing project. The help wanted is a document task rather than a health answer.

name: Describe symptoms without a question
definition: The participant states a symptom or health situation with no explicit question, implicitly asking the AI to assess it. The help wanted is an open-ended assessment of the stated problem.

name: Asking what is causing symptoms
definition: The participant describes their own or someone else's symptoms or experience and asks what could be causing it or what it means. The aim is an explanation or likely diagnosis for a specific personal situation.

name: Stating a symptom or result only
definition: The participant states a symptom, health detail or test result with no explicit question, leaving the AI to infer what help is wanted. These are often short phrases or pasted reports.

name: Asking what to do for relief
definition: The participant asks what they can do, take or change to treat, ease or manage a health problem. The aim is practical action, self-care or treatment advice.

name: Advice on whether to act
definition: The participant asks whether they should take a specific step, such as seeing a doctor or specialist, having a procedure, drinking alcohol, or calling for care. The aim is a judgement or go-ahead on a particular decision or its timing.

name: General health facts
definition: The participant asks for factual information about a condition, symptom, medicine, procedure or health measure in general, not tied to diagnosing their own case. Typical forms are what is, what are the symptoms of, what causes, or how often.

name: Personal plan or recommendations
definition: The participant sets out personal goals and current habits and asks for tailored recommendations, such as foods, meal ideas, supplements or a routine. The aim is a plan or product suggestions fitted to their goals rather than treatment of a problem.

name: Help with a text task
definition: The participant asks the AI to work on a piece of text, such as summarizing a section, drafting or reviewing writing, or incorporating an article into a project. The aim is a writing or document output rather than a health answer.

name: Possible cause of symptoms
definition: The participant describes their own or someone else's symptoms or changes and asks what might be causing them or what they mean. The aim is an explanation or likely diagnosis for a specific personal situation.

name: What to do for relief
definition: The participant asks what they (or the person they care for) should do, take or avoid to relieve, treat or manage a health problem or risk. The aim is practical action or self-care advice.

name: General health facts
definition: The participant asks for general information about a condition, symptom, test, procedure or medicine, not tied to explaining their own symptoms. This includes definitions, lists, norms, statistics, outcomes and what to expect.

name: Whether to seek medical care
definition: The participant asks whether they need a doctor, specialist, procedure or call to a care team, or when to make contact. The aim is a decision about using professional care.

name: Personal plan or product recommendations
definition: The participant states wellness goals or a project and asks for tailored recommendations, a plan, or a product that fits their needs. The focus is building or improving a routine (diet, supplements, fitness) rather than solving a symptom.

name: Information shared without a question
definition: The participant gives a symptom, situation or test result with no explicit question, leaving the AI to infer the request (usually an assessment). This includes pasted reports and bare symptom phrases.
